name: dev-start-phase-policy-drift
title: Reconcile dev_start phase policy: command-policy allowedPhases vs config DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS drift on INIT/DEV
description: The process-fact contract check (scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs, run via npm run test:process-fact-contract) fails on dev_start for the INIT and DEV phases with 'policy=true, isCommandAllowed=false'. Root cause: two sources of truth disagree about which phases permit dev_start. core/command-policy.ts declares dev_start allowedPhases = ['INIT','INIT_CHECK','PLAN','DEV'] (B-804c reason: an idempotent worktree (re-)bootstrap / recovery command allowed in the pre-REVIEW bootstrap window and refused in REVIEW/TEST/DONE). But core/config.ts DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS only lists dev_start under INIT_CHECK and PLAN (with a comment that story_advance internally calls dev_start so a standalone whitelist is only needed for the manual INIT_CHECK/PLAN recovery cases). The two disagree on INIT and DEV. Scope: (1) determine the correct phase set for dev_start by examining its actual recovery semantics (handlers/worktree.ts) and align command-policy.ts allowedPhases and config.ts DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS so they agree (decision: widen config up to the documented bootstrap window, OR narrow command-policy to match config — chosen in PLAN with rationale); (2) add/repair a regression guard so npm run test:process-fact-contract passes and a future dev_start phase divergence is caught. NOTE: this only reconciles the dev_start phase-policy drift; it does NOT change dev_start's behavior, the worktree bootstrap flow, or any other command's policy. All artifacts and emitted strings are English-only.
